title: UI refinements batch 1 (page gap, collapsible presets sidebar, AppCore bar occlusion)

decisions.text: Scope & process: 3 independent items -> 3 phases. Per-step atomic commits (step-id prefixed, Co-Authored-By); NO push; phase-boundary pauses; vue-tsc + bun green for UI steps. Item 3 commits in the AppCore repo; the re-synced AppMain.exe in MindWave stays gitignored (not committed).

Gap removal: zero the OUTER page padding (the <page>__inner wrapper) on all in-scope pages so the central block is flush with the window; inter-panel gaps stay (only padding -> 0, keep gap). Applies to base rule + responsive media-query overrides.
Presets sidebar collapse: reuse the Tracks-panel pattern -- filesPanelOpen ref persisted to localStorage, slide <transition>, sidebar removed from flow when closed. Default OPEN.

REVISED (owner 2026-07-01): toggle in the TOP-LEVEL menu bar (audio-page__tabs-bar), LEFT of the 'Плеер' tab (audio.playerTab), icon folder, label audio.filesTab (ru 'Файлы' / en 'Files'), aria-expanded/controls, active styling when open; toggles the shared filesPanelOpen. Top-level placement fits the shared presets sidebar (used by both Плеер and Редактор tabs). Not the player-view submenu.

AppCore fix: in updateBar hide the bar when the main window is NOT the foreground app (occluded/behind other windows) in addition to when minimized; show when the app returns to foreground. Detect via GetForegroundWindow + GetAncestor(GA_ROOTOWNER) identity, counting the bar (WS_EX_NOACTIVATE) as app-active.

steps.title: Plan & ledger
steps.verify: ledger JSON parses; dependsOn DAG acyclic; plan + ledger committed
evidence: Grounded in code: item1 = per-page <page>__inner padding:16px (SettingsPage .settings-page__inner, LogArchivePage .archive-page__inner, LogPage, AudioPage .audio-page__inner, BodyMonitor 3 pages); MainLayout q-page-container adds no padding. item2 = AudioPage audio-page__sidebar always-visible; mirror GnauralScheduleView trackPanelOpen/localStorage/transition/toggle; player menu = activePlayerViewTab tabs (main='Воспроизведение', spectrogram). item3 = AppBar.pas updateBar hides only on IsIconic; bar is WS_EX_TOPMOST; rebuild via build/win_x64/build_app.bat, re-sync via server/sync-appcore-launcher.ps1.
DAG acyclic: RF0.1 -> RF0.2 -> {RF1.1, RF2.1, RF3.1} (three independent phases).

steps.title: Approval gate (RF-D2/RF-D4/RF-D5)
steps.verify: owner confirms RF-D2 (padding->0, keep inter-panel gaps), RF-D4 (toggle button left of Плеер), RF-D5 (foreground-based hide). PAUSE before Phase 1.
evidence: Owner approved ('go') after RF-D4 revised to the top-level menu (left of 'Плеер'). RF-D2/RF-D3/RF-D5 accepted as drafted.

steps.title: Zero outer page padding (all screens)
steps.verify: <page>__inner padding set to 0 (base + media queries) on all in-scope pages; inter-panel gap kept; vue-tsc clean; content flush with window edge (visual owner check)
evidence: Zeroed outer padding on __inner wrappers (base + ≤768/960 media queries), keeping inter-panel gap: MindWaveCore SettingsPage (.settings-page__inner), LogArchivePage (.archive-page__inner). GnauralCore AudioPage (.audio-page__inner, keeps gap:16px).
Dropped the Quasar `padding` prop on q-page for the pages that used it (no __inner wrapper): MindWaveCore LogPage; BodyMonitorCore MonitoringPage, AlphaRelaxationPage, CalibrationPage.
Verify: `bun run typecheck` (vue-tsc --noEmit) in MindWaveCore/ui passed clean. Changes span 3 repos -> one RF1.1 commit each (MindWaveCore, GnauralCore, BodyMonitorCore).

steps.title: Collapsible presets sidebar + 'Файлы'/'Files' toggle
steps.verify: filesPanelOpen (localStorage-persisted) + slide transition hide/show the presets sidebar; 'Файлы'/'Files' toggle (folder icon, aria) sits left of the 'Плеер' tab in the top-level menu bar; audio.filesTab (+ show/hide aria) added to en/ru; vue-tsc + bun green

steps.title: AppCore control-bar occlusion fix
steps.verify: updateBar hides the bar when the main window is not foreground (behind other apps) + when minimized; shows when app returns to foreground; AppCore build_app.bat succeeds; AppMain.exe re-synced; committed in the AppCore repo
